_readme: Place a 'training_intro_sequences' object on each training interaction in interactions_training.json (same level as training_texts). Keys: first_refusal, second_refusal, learn_fail, trained (optional). Each value is a list of strings (one line per click in training_branch_narration) or one string with paragraphs separated by a blank line. Voice: see docs/writing/training_voice.md. learn_fail in training_texts: use only {pronoun} (and optional {roll}/{difficulty})—not {poss}/{subj} unless you extend the engine.

trained: Optional preamble clicks before success interaction_result.
